import argparse, json, runpy, signal, time
from pathlib import Path

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--source', required=True)
p.add_argument('--base', required=True)
p.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
a = p.parse_args()
assert not a.out.exists()
a.out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
h = runpy.run_path(str(a.repo / 'scripts/lifecycle_core.py'))
assert h['git'](a.repo, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == a.source
env = h['controlled_env']()
env.update(RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN='1.93.1', CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='1', RUST_TEST_THREADS='1', CARGO_NET_OFFLINE='true')
for n in [signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT]:
    signal.signal(n, lambda *_: h['run'].__globals__.__setitem__('CANCELLED', True))
proof = {'status': 'running', 'source_commit': a.source, 'base': a.base, 'commands': [], 'driver_sha256': h['digest'](Path(__file__))}
def save():
    (a.out / 'PROOF.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + '\n')
def run(name, argv, cwd=None):
    item = {'name': name, 'argv': argv, 'status': 'running'}
    proof['commands'].append(item)
    save()
    start = time.monotonic()
    log = a.out / (name + '.log')
    try:
        h['run'](argv, cwd=cwd or a.repo / 'compiler', timeout=900, limit=24*1024**2, env=env, log_path=log)
        item.update(status='passed', exit=0)
        print(name + ': passed', flush=True)
    finally:
        item['seconds'] = time.monotonic() - start
        if log.exists(): item['log_sha256'] = h['digest'](log)
        save()
try:
    run('summary', ['cargo', 'run', '--locked', '--', 'çalıştır', '../dogfood/kanit-ozeti/kaynak/ana.dil'])
    run('documentation', ['cargo', 'test', '--locked', '--test', 'katalog_testi', '--test', 'dokuman_tazelik_testi'])
    run('spec-drift', ['cargo', 'run', '--locked', '--bin', 'spec_drift', '--', '--denetle'])
    run('fmt', ['cargo', 'fmt', '--all', '--', '--check'])
    for name in ['conformance', 'semantic-regresyon', 'core-freeze']:
        run(name + '-guard', ['bash', 'scripts/' + name + '-korugu.sh', a.base], a.repo)
    run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'], a.repo)
    run('secret-scan', ['bash', 'scripts/sir-taramasi.sh'], a.repo)
    assert h['git'](a.repo, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == a.source
    proof['status'] = 'passed'
except BaseException as error:
    proof.update(status='failed', failure_type=type(error).__name__)
    raise
finally:
    save()
